entries.title: Praesos: Eteocretan inscription (the nomos-fragment)
entries.archive_unit: glass negative; copy negative, not the inscribed stone
entries.catalogue_bibliography: BSA 8: 125, publication dated 1901 in archive record

basis: The BSA archive title identifies the negative as the nomos-fragment and cites BSA 8:125.
Conway BSA 8 calls the newly discovered nomos inscription Pr. II; the project's Praisos 2 historical reading on printed p. 127 contains sanomoselos.
The project distinguishes this source-identity join from museum accession, present physical location and direct image collation.
project_object_join.article_locator: BSA 8 (1902), pp. 125-156; Pr. II conservative/probable transliterations at printed p. 127

entries.image_rights: not_assessed; no image downloaded or redistributed

boundary: An archival reproduction is not a new ancient witness. The archive-title/primary-edition crosswalk identifies the project source identity as Praisos 2; it does not establish a museum accession, present physical location, image rights or a new independent reading.
